records.tagline: iPhone 17e delivers incredible value with faster performance
records.description: Apple today announced iPhone 17e, a powerful and more affordable addition to the iPhone 17 lineup. At the heart of iPhone 17e is the latest-generation A19, which delivers exceptional performance for everything users do. iPhone 17e also features C1X, the latest-generation cellular modem designed by Apple, which is up to 2x faster than C1 in iPhone 16e.

records.name: EasyClaw
records.tagline: Install OpenClaw AI agent with one click
records.description: EasyClaw is a free, open-source desktop app that installs OpenClaw AI agent in three steps: download, run, and enter your API key. No terminal commands needed. It auto-detects your environment, installs dependencies (Node.js, WSL on Windows), configures your AI provider (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, MiniMax, GLM), and sets up Telegram integration so you can chat with your AI agent from your phone. Built with Electron, React 19, TypeScript. Available in English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese.

records.name: Homeschool.fit
records.tagline: Plan your curriculum. Run your group. Grow your community.
records.description: Homeschool families juggle many apps. Facebook groups for community, Band or Slack for chat, spreadsheets for curriculum, signup genius, sites for co-op scheduling and dues, homeschool-life for public listings. Homeschool.fit replaces all of them. One platform for curriculum planning, real-time group chat, co-op scheduling with sign-ups, events, polls, dues collection, work sample portfolios for charter reporting, a living books library, and community discovery. Built by a homeschool family.

records.name: Kamero.ai: AI Event Photo Sharing
records.tagline: Real-time AI Face Recognition & Instant Camera - Cloud Sync
records.description: Kamero.ai is a mobile-first AI photo-sharing platform that eliminates the "waiting game" for event photos. Unlike generic cloud storage, we offer: • Kam-Sync: Real-time FTP camera-to-cloud upload. • AI Face Match: Guests find their photos in seconds with a selfie. • White-Label Apps: Photographers deliver under their own brand. • Privacy-First: Secure PINs and face-based access controls. Stop using Google Drive for events. Start delivering memories in real-time.

records.name: Tixin
records.tagline: Host your event, without any restrictions!
records.description: Book and host events easily with Tixin. India's premier event management platform with inbuilt payment integration, automated ticket checking, custom event pages with personalized themes, and complete vendor management. Connect with sponsors, artists, and venues. Host fests, hackathons, concerts & workshops with detailed analytics. Seamless booking experience for attendees.

records.name: Plyr
records.tagline: A feature-rich media player embedded directly inside VSCode.
records.description: Error Sound — Plays a configurable audio alert when opening files with diagnostics, with custom sounds and cooldowns - Uninterrupted Flow — Watch tutorials, listen to music, or review media without leaving VS Code - Persistent State — Playlist and settings survive sidebar toggles and editor restarts - Full Media Support — Plays audio (MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC, M4A, WAV) and video (MP4, WEBM, MKV, AVI, MOV)

records.name: Syncverse Solutions
records.tagline: Turning Business Data into Smarter Decisions
records.description: Syncverse Solutions helps businesses scale using Zoho, ERP, Analytics, and intelligent automation systems. Purpose-built platforms for retail, hospitality, and modern enterprises.

records.name: Bloom Circlet Rhodium Plated Bangles
records.tagline: Bloom Circlet Rhodium Plated Bangles
records.description: The Bloom Circlet Rhodium Plated Bangles showcase exquisite craftsmanship with their floral-inspired design elements. The lustrous rhodium plating imparts a sophisticated silver sheen while ensuring exceptional durability and tarnish resistance. These elegant circlets feature delicate bloom motifs that encircle the wrist with refined grace, creating a subtle yet distinctive statement for discerning tastes.

records.name: Secret Sauce 3D
records.tagline: AI tool suite for professional 3D artists
records.description: Secret Sauce 3D is an AI co-pilot built for 3D artists and 3D enthusiasts. Generate high-poly starting points, segment into parts, optimise geometry, create UVs, and build texture bases — all with editable outputs at every step. Get a starting point for each step of the 3D pipeline so that you don’t have to start building from scratch, and use AI tools that integrate directly into your existing pipeline.

records.name: Qwen3.5 Small
records.tagline: 0.8B-9B native multimodal w/ more intelligence, less compute
records.description: Qwen just released the Qwen3.5 Small Model Series — 0.8B, 2B, 4B and 9B. Native multimodal with improved architecture and scaled RL. 0.8B and 2B are tiny and fast for edge devices, 4B makes a strong lightweight agent base, and 9B is already closing the gap with much larger models. Base versions released too.

records.name: ReceiptRecon
records.tagline: AI Receipt Scanner for Freelancers
records.description: Best receipt scanner app for business. AI receipt scanner with automatic receipt scanning, receipt capture, receipt tracking, expense tracking, bank statement scanner, and receipt management software. Free receipt tracker app for small business.

records.name: Orbiters
records.tagline: A beautiful 3D Solar System you can explore
records.description: Orbiters is a 3D Solar System explorer for iPad. Fly around planets and moons, zoom from system view to close-up, and learn with clean, bite-size facts. Realistic lighting and a calm UI make it great for quick discovery, learning, or just relaxing space browsing. Built for smooth, touch-first navigation and beautiful visuals.

records.name: Piksi
records.tagline: Your phone camera detects the words you don't know
records.description: You're reading. You hit a word you don't know. You tell yourself you'll look it up later. You never do. Piksi fixes that. Point your camera at a text: it runs on-device tech and pulls out only the words that are actually worth learning. Captured in under 5 seconds, zero typing. Definitions appear and spaced repetition brings them back until they're yours forever. Language learner mode included to show more words.

records.name: EveryTransfer
records.tagline: Secure File Sharing & Privacy-First Converter Tools
records.description: EveryTransfer is a secure file sharing platform to send large files freely. Featuring a new suite of 100% private, client-side file converter tools—convert & compress videos, images, and PDFs directly in your browser without compromising privacy.

records.name: Trickle
records.tagline: Meetings handled. Follow-up too.
records.description: Most people running a lot of meetings are paying for a note-taker, a scheduler, a calendar sync, and something to tame their inbox. Separately. Trickle replaces all of it. One agent that joins your meetings, handles follow-up, manages your calendar across providers, labels your inbox, and schedules directly from email. Built in Europe. EU data hosting. Strong on multilingual meetings because real meetings don't sound like demos.

records.name: QuickProof
records.tagline: Collect visual feedback without messy email threads

records.name: YAPL

records.description: Project management shouldn't feel like a second job. Meet YAPL: the all-in-one platform that turns chaotic roadmaps into clear, executable plans. With interactive Gantt charts, smart resource balancing, and real-time team sync, you'll ship faster without the burnout. Buttery-smooth Gantt charts, effortless resource management, and a eye catching UI. I ditched the bloat and over-engineering for a beautiful, blazing-fast experience. Stop managing tools and start managing success. 🚀

records.name: Resunote
records.tagline: The AI platform for smarter job preparation
records.description: Resunote is an AI-powered job preparation platform that helps you go beyond resume building. Paste a job description and get a personalized prep workflow: tailored resume, targeted cover letter, skill gap analysis, and role-specific interview guidance. Instead of just generating documents, Resunote helps you understand what the company wants and prepare strategically to apply with confidence.

Experience true "Situation Puzzles" by typing questions to an AI Game Master that strictly answers Yes, No, or Irrelevant. Interrogate suspects, play solo or in online co-op, and watch the scene and music shift as you uncover the truth. You can also submit custom cases for the AI to host, or join the Tearoom to discuss theories.

records.description: Paste a post. Or a concept. Plus, measure how your thinking sparks your audience's thinking with impact metrics.

records.description: Pull a shot. Tell Grindset it tastes sour. It tells you: grind 2 clicks finer, aim for 36g yield, target 28 seconds. Pull again. Three shots later, you're dialed in. records.description: TronDealer is a B2B crypto payment gateway that generates unique deposit wallets per customer, detects on-chain deposits automatically, and consolidates funds to your wallet — all via a simple API. records.name: 3D Print Pro: Cost & Fleet Manager

records.description: PrintQuote Pro helps small 3D print farms calculate real profit per job by factoring in material, machine wear, electricity, failure rates, and waste. This tool turns 3D printing from guesswork pricing into a structured, profit-driven process. Built for makers running a business, not a hobby. 100% Offline.

records.name: Password Locker
records.tagline: Let's see if you're smart enough to crack the codes!
records.description: Password Locker stands out by focusing on real code-breaking instead of repetitive puzzles. Players solve actual ciphers like Caesar shifts, reversed text, and number-letter codes. The goal isn’t speed, but the satisfaction of thinking and feeling smarter. With a clean hacker-style design, short sessions, and easy access, it turns cryptography into a simple, fun daily brain workout.

records.name: Harbor Markets

records.description: We combine cross-chain swapping and bridging across 60+ chains with live TradingView charts and real-time market news. Unlike the cartoon-themed platforms that dominate DeFi, Harbor Markets was designed with a single principle: serious capital deserves a serious platform. We never hold your funds. Every swap and bridge is executed through battle-tested backend infrastructure, meaning you stay in complete control of your assets at all times.

records.name: GoodCoach

records.description: Meet GoodCoach: the unified workspace bringing elite athletic insights and tools to every team. Coaching 30+ players makes individual visibility impossible... until now. Features include a drag-and-drop workout builder, team hub, and season planning. Unlike basic filing cabinet software, GoodCoach analyzes physiological trends to suggest proactive actions. Move from plan to improvement faster, prevent injuries, and unlock your entire roster’s potential.

records.name: SquadProof

records.description: SquadProof turns group goals into clear commitments. Instead of chat threads or editable spreadsheets, each challenge has a deadline, a shared invite link, and a locked Done or Missed outcome. You get a clear record of follow-through and who is falling behind.

records.name: Reusable Cleaning Cloth

Lightweight and durable, it can be used over and over again, reducing waste from disposable paper towels and wipes.

records.name: SewConnect

records.description: SewConnect is a marketplace to discover and book trusted African designers, tailors and seamstresses worldwide. Custom fashion is still referral-based and hard to verify. records.name: xR2 Prompt Manager
records.tagline: Manage AI prompts like product features, not code
records.description: Prompt management with business metrics, not just debug traces. A/B test prompts with statistical significance. Build conversion funnels from prompt to revenue. records.name: Ferct

records.name: BookShelves eBook Reader
records.tagline: ebook reader & library — no ads, no subscriptions
records.description: BookShelves is a native ebook reader and library for macOS and iOS. Browse thousands of free public domain classics from Standard Ebooks and Internet Archive right from the app. Your library syncs across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Built for readers who want a beautiful, private reading experience without the bloat.

records.name: PDFify
records.tagline: PDFify it — because life's too short for bad formats
records.description: PDFify is the free online PDF editor that lets you sign PDF, edit PDF, compress PDF, merge PDF, split PDF, and translate PDF — no watermark, works on mobile and desktop.

records.name: ProfitPilot

records.description: I built ProfitPilot after realizing many online sellers unknowingly lose money due to hidden fees, ads, VAT, and pricing mistakes.
